Supplementary code report. The source code is shown in full. The confidential input data are not embedded in this file.

1 Purpose of the Empirical Script

This report contains the code used to prepare the empirical results for the thesis. It builds the weekly Dietikon–Zurich panel, reports descriptive period comparisons, estimates the fixed-effects and event-based models, examines store heterogeneity, and analyses monthly productivity and NPS separately.

The code checks the input files and key variables before estimation. Duplicate store-week records, missing values, zero values, and models that cannot be estimated are documented in the diagnostics folder. The combined ticket file without store identifiers is retained only as a network-level reference and is not merged into the store-level panel.

The report also exports the tables and figures used in the thesis. Figures are written to output/figures_png, tables to output/tables_png, and appendix-ready copies to output/appendix_png.

model_log <- tibble(
  model_group = character(),
  outcome = character(),
  transform = character(),
  status = character(),
  reason = character()
)

log_model_status <- function(model_group, outcome, transform, status, reason = "") {
  model_log <<- bind_rows(
    model_log,
    tibble(
      model_group = model_group,
      outcome = outcome,
      transform = transform,
      status = status,
      reason = reason
    )
  )
}

require_file <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    stop(glue("File not found: {path}"), call. = FALSE)
  }
  invisible(TRUE)
}

require_cols <- function(data, cols, data_name = "data") {
  missing_cols <- setdiff(cols, names(data))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop(glue("{data_name} is missing required columns: {paste(missing_cols, collapse = ', ')}"), call. = FALSE)
  }
  invisible(TRUE)
}

parse_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.numeric(x)) return(x)
  x %>%
    as.character() %>%
    str_replace_all("'", "") %>%
    str_replace_all("%", "") %>%
    str_replace_all(",", ".") %>%
    na_if("") %>%
    as.numeric()
}

safe_log <- function(x) {
  # Non-positive values cannot enter the log specification.
  if_else(!is.na(x) & is.finite(x) & x > 0, log(x), NA_real_)
}

safe_log1p <- function(x) {
  # log1p retains zero values; negative values are excluded.
  if_else(!is.na(x) & is.finite(x) & x >= 0, log1p(x), NA_real_)
}

parse_week_date <- function(x) {
  suppressWarnings(dmy(as.character(x)))
}

parse_nps_month <- function(x) {
  # Normalise the month labels used in the NPS export.
  x_clean <- as.character(x) %>%
    str_replace_all("\\.", "") %>%
    str_replace("^Sept", "Sep")
  suppressWarnings(parse_date_time(paste("01", x_clean), orders = c("d b y", "d B y"))) %>%
    as.Date() %>%
    floor_date("month")
}

check_unique_key <- function(data, key_cols, data_name = "data") {
  dup <- data %>%
    count(across(all_of(key_cols)), name = "n") %>%
    filter(n > 1)
  if (nrow(dup) > 0) {
    write_csv(dup, file.path(output_dir, "diagnostics", paste0(data_name, "_duplicate_keys.csv")))
    stop(glue("Duplicate keys found in {data_name}. See diagnostics/{data_name}_duplicate_keys.csv"), call. = FALSE)
  }
  invisible(TRUE)
}

make_data_quality_report <- function(data, id_cols = c("store", "week_start"), data_name = "weekly_panel") {
  numeric_cols <- names(data)[map_lgl(data, is.numeric)]
  report <- tibble(variable = numeric_cols) %>%
    mutate(
      n_total = nrow(data),
      n_missing = map_int(variable, ~ sum(is.na(data[[.x]]))),
      share_missing = n_missing / n_total,
      n_zero = map_int(variable, ~ sum(data[[.x]] == 0, na.rm = TRUE)),
      n_negative = map_int(variable, ~ sum(data[[.x]] < 0, na.rm = TRUE)),
      n_nonfinite = map_int(variable, ~ sum(!is.finite(data[[.x]]) & !is.na(data[[.x]]))),
      n_distinct = map_int(variable, ~ n_distinct(data[[.x]], na.rm = TRUE)),
      min = map_dbl(variable, ~ suppressWarnings(min(data[[.x]], na.rm = TRUE))),
      max = map_dbl(variable, ~ suppressWarnings(max(data[[.x]], na.rm = TRUE))),
      mean = map_dbl(variable, ~ suppressWarnings(mean(data[[.x]], na.rm = TRUE)))
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      min = if_else(is.infinite(min), NA_real_, min),
      max = if_else(is.infinite(max), NA_real_, max),
      mean = if_else(is.nan(mean), NA_real_, mean)
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(share_missing), desc(n_zero))
  
  write_csv(report, file.path(output_dir, "diagnostics", paste0(data_name, "_quality_report.csv")))
  report
}

add_log_variables <- function(data) {
  numeric_cols <- names(data)[map_lgl(data, is.numeric)]
  numeric_cols <- setdiff(numeric_cols, c("year", "month", "week_number", "week_of_year", "time_index",
                                         "covid", "postcovid", "newnormal",
                                         "fee_post", "steg_post", "melectronics_post", "competitor_post", "same_day_end_post"))
  data %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(numeric_cols), safe_log, .names = "ln_{.col}")) %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(numeric_cols), safe_log1p, .names = "ln1p_{.col}"))
}

has_usable_variation <- function(data, var) {
  if (!var %in% names(data)) return(FALSE)
  x <- data[[var]]
  x <- x[!is.na(x) & is.finite(x)]
  length(x) >= 20 && n_distinct(x) > 1
}

available_vars <- function(vars, data) {
  vars[vars %in% names(data)]
}

rename_models_for_thesis <- function(models) {
  models <- purrr::compact(models)
  if (length(models) == 0) return(models)
  old_names <- names(models)
  new_names <- if_else(
    old_names %in% names(model_label_map),
    unname(model_label_map[old_names]),
    old_names
  )
  names(models) <- new_names
  models
}

select_model_subset <- function(models, wanted) {
  models <- purrr::compact(models)
  models[intersect(wanted, names(models))]
}

write_png_table <- function(df, filename, title = NULL, note = NULL,
                            digits = 2, subdir = "tables_png",
                            base_width = 1800, row_height = 42,
                            font_size = 9, title_size = 13,
                            note_size = 8) {
  # Render tables directly with gridExtra.

  if (!str_detect(filename, "\\.png$")) {
    filename <- paste0(filename, ".png")
  }

  png_file <- file.path(output_dir, subdir, filename)

  df_display <- df %>%
    as.data.frame(check.names = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.factor), as.character)) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.Date), as.character))

  # Format numeric columns before drawing the table.
  numeric_cols <- names(df_display)[map_lgl(df_display, is.numeric)]
  if (length(numeric_cols) > 0) {
    df_display <- df_display %>%
      mutate(across(
        all_of(numeric_cols),
        ~ ifelse(
          is.na(.x),
          "",
          formatC(.x, format = "f", digits = digits, big.mark = "'", decimal.mark = ".")
        )
      ))
  }

  df_display <- df_display %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.na(.x), "", as.character(.x))))

  # Adapt the image size to the number of rows and columns.
  n_cols <- max(1, ncol(df_display))
  n_rows <- max(1, nrow(df_display))
  dynamic_font_size <- ifelse(n_cols >= 8, max(6, font_size - 2), font_size)
  dynamic_width <- max(base_width, n_cols * 230)
  dynamic_height <- max(700, (n_rows + 2) * row_height + 180)

  table_theme <- gridExtra::ttheme_minimal(
    base_size = dynamic_font_size,
    core = list(
      fg_params = list(hjust = 0, x = 0.03),
      padding = unit(c(4, 4), "mm")
    ),
    colhead = list(
      fg_params = list(fontface = "bold", hjust = 0, x = 0.03),
      padding = unit(c(4, 4), "mm")
    )
  )

  table_grob <- gridExtra::tableGrob(df_display, rows = NULL, theme = table_theme)

  top_grob <- if (!is.null(title)) {
    grid::textGrob(
      title,
      x = 0,
      hjust = 0,
      gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = title_size, fontface = "bold")
    )
  } else {
    NULL
  }

  bottom_grob <- if (!is.null(note)) {
    grid::textGrob(
      note,
      x = 0,
      hjust = 0,
      gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = note_size)
    )
  } else {
    NULL
  }

  combined <- gridExtra::arrangeGrob(
    table_grob,
    top = top_grob,
    bottom = bottom_grob,
    padding = unit(0.6, "line")
  )

  grDevices::png(
    filename = png_file,
    width = dynamic_width,
    height = dynamic_height,
    res = 160,
    bg = "white"
  )
  grid::grid.newpage()
  grid::grid.draw(combined)
  grDevices::dev.off()

  # Keep an appendix-ready copy.
  if (file.exists(png_file) && subdir != "appendix_png") {
    file.copy(png_file, appendix_png_path(filename), overwrite = TRUE)
  }

  invisible(png_file)
}

save_df_table_png <- function(df, filename, title = NULL, note = NULL, digits = 2,
                              vwidth = 1600, vheight = 1000) {
  # vheight is retained for compatibility with earlier calls.
  write_png_table(
    df = df,
    filename = filename,
    title = title,
    note = note,
    digits = digits,
    subdir = "tables_png",
    base_width = vwidth
  )
}

save_plot_png <- function(plot_obj, filename, width = 10, height = 5.5, dpi = 300) {
  # Save the working copy and an appendix-ready copy.
  if (is.null(plot_obj)) return(invisible(NULL))
  if (!str_detect(filename, "\\.png$")) {
    filename <- paste0(filename, ".png")
  }

  ggsave(
    filename = figure_png_path(filename),
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = dpi,
    units = "in",
    bg = "white"
  )
  file.copy(figure_png_path(filename), appendix_png_path(filename), overwrite = TRUE)
  invisible(figure_png_path(filename))
}

save_model_table <- function(models, filename, title = NULL, notes = default_table_notes) {
  models <- purrr::compact(models)
  if (length(models) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))

  models_pretty <- rename_models_for_thesis(models)
  filename_stub <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(filename))

  # Editable LaTeX version.
  modelsummary(
    models_pretty,
    output = file.path(output_dir, "tables", paste0(filename_stub, ".tex")),
    stars = star_levels,
    estimate = "{estimate}{stars}",
    statistic = "({std.error})",
    coef_map = coef_label_map,
    title = title,
    notes = notes,
    gof_map = compact_gof_map,
    fmt = 3
  )

  # HTML version for checking the output.
  modelsummary(
    models_pretty,
    output = file.path(output_dir, "tables", paste0(filename_stub, ".html")),
    stars = star_levels,
    estimate = "{estimate}{stars}",
    statistic = "({std.error})",
    coef_map = coef_label_map,
    title = title,
    notes = notes,
    gof_map = compact_gof_map,
    fmt = 3
  )

  # PNG version used in the appendix.
  model_df <- modelsummary(
    models_pretty,
    output = "data.frame",
    stars = star_levels,
    estimate = "{estimate}{stars}",
    statistic = "({std.error})",
    coef_map = coef_label_map,
    gof_map = compact_gof_map,
    fmt = 3
  ) %>%
    as.data.frame(check.names = FALSE)

  # Prepare the modelsummary data frame for image rendering.
  if ("part" %in% names(model_df)) {
    model_df <- model_df %>% select(-part)
  }
  names(model_df) <- names(model_df) %>%
    str_replace("^term$", "Term") %>%
    str_replace("^statistic$", "Statistic")

  table_note <- paste(notes, collapse = " ")

  write_png_table(
    df = model_df,
    filename = paste0(filename_stub, ".png"),
    title = title,
    note = table_note,
    digits = 3,
    subdir = "tables_png",
    base_width = 2200,
    row_height = 40,
    font_size = 8,
    title_size = 13,
    note_size = 8
  )

  invisible(NULL)
}

display_model_table <- function(models, title = NULL, notes = default_table_notes) {
  models <- purrr::compact(models)
  if (length(models) == 0) {
    cat("\\textit{No models are displayed because the relevant variables or event dates are not available. See the model log in the diagnostics folder.}\n\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  modelsummary(
    rename_models_for_thesis(models),
    stars = star_levels,
    estimate = "{estimate}{stars}",
    statistic = "({std.error})",
    coef_map = coef_label_map,
    title = title,
    notes = notes,
    gof_map = compact_gof_map,
    fmt = 3
  )
}

plot_event_coefficients <- function(models, title, filename) {
  models <- purrr::compact(models)
  if (length(models) == 0) {
    cat("\\textit{No coefficient plot is displayed because no event models were estimated.}\n\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  coef_df <- imap_dfr(models, function(model, outcome_name) {
    broom::tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
      filter(!str_detect(term, "Intercept")) %>%
      mutate(
        outcome = if_else(
          outcome_name %in% names(model_label_map),
          unname(model_label_map[outcome_name]),
          outcome_name
        ),
        term_label = if_else(
          term %in% names(coef_label_map),
          unname(coef_label_map[term]),
          term
        )
      )
  })

  if (nrow(coef_df) == 0) {
    cat("\\textit{No event coefficients are available for plotting.}\n\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  p <- ggplot(coef_df, aes(x = estimate, y = reorder(outcome, estimate))) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), height = 0.18) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    facet_wrap(~ term_label, scales = "free_x") +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = "Whiskers show 95% confidence intervals; regression tables report significance stars.",
      x = "Estimated coefficient with 95% confidence interval",
      y = NULL
    )

  print(p)
  ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "figures", filename), p, width = 9, height = 5, bg = "white")
  save_plot_png(p, filename, width = 9, height = 5)
  invisible(p)
}

run_fe_model <- function(data, outcome, rhs, model_group, transform = c("level", "log", "log1p"),
                         fixed_effects = "store + week_of_year_fe",
                         min_n = 30) {
  transform <- match.arg(transform)
  
  y <- case_when(
    transform == "level" ~ outcome,
    transform == "log" ~ paste0("ln_", outcome),
    transform == "log1p" ~ paste0("ln1p_", outcome)
  )
  
  if (!y %in% names(data)) {
    log_model_status(model_group, outcome, transform, "skipped", glue("Outcome variable {y} not found."))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  rhs_vars <- all.vars(as.formula(paste("~", rhs)))
  missing_rhs <- setdiff(rhs_vars, names(data))
  if (length(missing_rhs) > 0) {
    log_model_status(model_group, outcome, transform, "skipped", glue("Missing RHS variable(s): {paste(missing_rhs, collapse = ', ')}"))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  required_for_model <- unique(c(y, rhs_vars, all.vars(as.formula(paste("~", fixed_effects)))))
  model_data <- data %>%
    select(all_of(required_for_model)) %>%
    drop_na()
  
  if (nrow(model_data) < min_n) {
    log_model_status(model_group, outcome, transform, "skipped", glue("Too few complete observations: {nrow(model_data)}."))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  if (n_distinct(model_data[[y]]) <= 1) {
    log_model_status(model_group, outcome, transform, "skipped", "Outcome has no usable variation after filtering.")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  rhs_no_functions <- rhs_vars
  no_variation_rhs <- rhs_no_functions[map_lgl(rhs_no_functions, ~ n_distinct(model_data[[.x]]) <= 1)]
  if (length(no_variation_rhs) > 0) {
    log_model_status(model_group, outcome, transform, "skipped", glue("RHS variable(s) have no variation: {paste(no_variation_rhs, collapse = ', ')}"))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  fml <- as.formula(glue("{y} ~ {rhs} | {fixed_effects}"))
  
  fit <- tryCatch(
    feols(fml, data = data, vcov = "hetero", notes = FALSE),
    error = function(e) e
  )
  
  if (inherits(fit, "error")) {
    log_model_status(model_group, outcome, transform, "error", fit$message)
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  log_model_status(model_group, outcome, transform, "estimated", "")
  fit
}

event_week_start <- function(event_date) {
  # Convert event dates to the Monday of the corresponding week.

  x <- event_date
  if (!inherits(x, "Date")) {
    x <- as.Date(x)
  }
  as.Date(floor_date(x, unit = "week", week_start = 1))
}

make_post_dummy <- function(date_var, event_date) {
  if (length(event_date) == 0 || is.na(event_date)) return(rep(NA_integer_, length(date_var)))
  as.integer(date_var >= event_week_start(event_date))
}

plot_weekly_series <- function(data, y_var, title, y_label = NULL,
                               trim_outliers = trim_plot_outliers,
                               q_low = plot_quantile_low,
                               q_high = plot_quantile_high) {
  if (!y_var %in% names(data)) return(NULL)

  plot_data <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[y_var]]), is.finite(.data[[y_var]]))

  subtitle_text <- "Descriptive plot; model estimates use the full untrimmed sample."

  if (trim_outliers && nrow(plot_data) > 0) {
    qs <- quantile(plot_data[[y_var]], probs = c(q_low, q_high), na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE)

    if (length(qs) == 2 && all(is.finite(qs)) && qs[1] < qs[2]) {
      outlier_rows <- plot_data %>%
        filter(.data[[y_var]] < qs[1] | .data[[y_var]] > qs[2]) %>%
        select(store, week_start, all_of(y_var))

      if (nrow(outlier_rows) > 0) {
        write_csv(
          outlier_rows,
          file.path(output_dir, "diagnostics", paste0("plot_outliers_removed_", y_var, ".csv"))
        )
      }

      plot_data <- plot_data %>%
        filter(.data[[y_var]] >= qs[1], .data[[y_var]] <= qs[2])

      subtitle_text <- glue(
        "Displayed after trimming values below p{100*q_low} and above p{100*q_high}; regressions use the full untrimmed sample."
      )
    }
  }

  ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = week_start, y = .data[[y_var]], colour = store)) +
    geom_line(alpha = 0.65, na.rm = TRUE) +
    geom_smooth(se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.75, na.rm = TRUE) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = subtitle_text,
      x = NULL,
      y = y_label %||% y_var,
      colour = "Store"
    )
}

2 Data Construction and Diagnostics

The empirical panel is constructed from internal KPI, ticketing and NPS exports. Raw diagnostics are written to the diagnostics folder, while this report displays only the compact checks needed to document the data structure used for the thesis analysis.

require_file(kpi_file)

kpi_raw <- read_csv(kpi_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  clean_names()

require_cols(kpi_raw, c("site_id", "name", "value", "date", "site_abbreviation", "week", "year"), "KPI data")

glimpse(kpi_raw)

kpi_name_map <- c(
  "Total turnover generated in Retail" = "total_turnover",
  "Direct Turnover (All product types)" = "direct_turnover_all",
  "Direct Turnover (only relevant product types)" = "direct_turnover_relevant",
  "Turnover - Ordered in Retail for collection" = "turnover_ordered_collection",
  "Turnover - Added in Retail for collection" = "turnover_added_collection",
  "Turnover - Ordered in Retail for shipment" = "turnover_ordered_shipment",
  "Turnover - Added in Retail for shipment" = "turnover_added_shipment",
  "Turnover Collected" = "turnover_collected",
  "Deliveries collected" = "deliveries_collected",
  "Number of tickets created" = "tickets_created_kpi",
  "Turnover generated per ticket created" = "turnover_per_ticket",
  "Productivity" = "productivity"
)

kpi_name_audit <- kpi_raw %>%
  count(name, sort = TRUE)

write_csv(kpi_name_audit, file.path(output_dir, "diagnostics", "kpi_raw_name_audit.csv"))
kpi_name_audit

# Sum flow variables within each store-week and average ratio variables.

ratio_kpis <- c("turnover_per_ticket", "productivity")

kpi_weekly <- kpi_raw %>%
  mutate(
    store = as.character(site_abbreviation),
    date = dmy(date),
    value = parse_numeric(value),
    kpi = recode(name, !!!kpi_name_map, .default = NA_character_),
    week_start = floor_date(date, unit = "week", week_start = 1)
  ) %>%
  filter(store %in% c("DT", "ZH")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(kpi)) %>%
  filter(date >= analysis_start, date <= analysis_end) %>%
  group_by(store, week_start, kpi) %>%
  summarise(
    value = if_else(first(kpi) %in% ratio_kpis,
                    mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
                    sum(value, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = kpi, values_from = value) %>%
  arrange(store, week_start) %>%
  mutate(
    year = year(week_start),
    month = month(week_start),
    week_of_year = isoweek(week_start),
    month_start = floor_date(week_start, "month"),
    direct_turnover = coalesce(direct_turnover_all, direct_turnover_relevant),
    collection_turnover = coalesce(turnover_ordered_collection, 0) + coalesce(turnover_added_collection, 0),
    shipment_turnover = coalesce(turnover_ordered_shipment, 0) + coalesce(turnover_added_shipment, 0),
    collection_share_turnover = if_else(total_turnover > 0, collection_turnover / total_turnover, NA_real_),
    shipment_share_turnover = if_else(total_turnover > 0, shipment_turnover / total_turnover, NA_real_),
    direct_share_turnover = if_else(total_turnover > 0, direct_turnover / total_turnover, NA_real_),
    throughput_proxy = turnover_per_ticket
  )

check_unique_key(kpi_weekly, c("store", "week_start"), "kpi_weekly")

kpi_quality <- make_data_quality_report(kpi_weekly, data_name = "kpi_weekly")
kpi_quality

write_csv(kpi_weekly, file.path(output_dir, "clean_data", "kpi_weekly_dt_zh.csv"))
read_tickets_store <- function(path, store_code) {
  require_file(path)
  read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE, locale = locale(encoding = "UTF-8")) %>%
    clean_names() %>%
    mutate(store = store_code)
}

tickets_dt <- read_tickets_store(tickets_file_dt, "DT")
tickets_zh <- read_tickets_store(tickets_file_zh, "ZH")

tickets_weekly <- bind_rows(tickets_dt, tickets_zh)

require_cols(
  tickets_weekly,
  c("week_start", "year", "week_number", "total_tickets", "tickets_abholung", "tickets_beratung",
    "avg_waiting_time_abholung", "avg_waiting_time_beratung",
    "median_waiting_time_abholung", "median_waiting_time_beratung",
    "avg_duration_abholung", "avg_duration_beratung",
    "median_duration_abholung", "median_duration_beratung", "store"),
  "Ticket data"
)

tickets_weekly_raw_parsed <- tickets_weekly %>%
  mutate(
    week_start = parse_week_date(week_start),
    year = year(week_start),
    month = month(week_start),
    week_of_year = isoweek(week_start),
    month_start = floor_date(week_start, "month"),
    across(
      c(total_tickets, tickets_abholung, tickets_beratung,
        avg_waiting_time_abholung, avg_waiting_time_beratung,
        median_waiting_time_abholung, median_waiting_time_beratung,
        avg_duration_abholung, avg_duration_beratung,
        median_duration_abholung, median_duration_beratung),
      parse_numeric
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(week_start >= analysis_start, week_start <= analysis_end)

# Collapse duplicate ticket rows to one store-week observation.
# Counts are summed; waiting-time and duration averages use ticket weights.
# Medians cannot be reconstructed exactly and are averaged.

ticket_duplicate_keys <- tickets_weekly_raw_parsed %>%
  count(store, week_start, name = "n_rows") %>%
  filter(n_rows > 1)

if (nrow(ticket_duplicate_keys) > 0) {
  tickets_weekly_raw_parsed %>%
    semi_join(ticket_duplicate_keys, by = c("store", "week_start")) %>%
    arrange(store, week_start) %>%
    write_csv(file.path(output_dir, "diagnostics", "tickets_weekly_duplicate_rows_before_collapse.csv"))
}

weighted_mean_safe <- function(x, w) {
  if (all(is.na(x))) return(NA_real_)
  if (all(is.na(w)) || sum(w, na.rm = TRUE) <= 0) return(mean(x, na.rm = TRUE))
  weighted.mean(x, w = replace_na(w, 0), na.rm = TRUE)
}

tickets_weekly <- tickets_weekly_raw_parsed %>%
  group_by(store, week_start) %>%
  summarise(
    # Compute weighted averages before replacing counts with weekly sums.

    avg_waiting_time_abholung = weighted_mean_safe(avg_waiting_time_abholung, tickets_abholung),
    avg_waiting_time_beratung = weighted_mean_safe(avg_waiting_time_beratung, tickets_beratung),
    avg_duration_abholung = weighted_mean_safe(avg_duration_abholung, tickets_abholung),
    avg_duration_beratung = weighted_mean_safe(avg_duration_beratung, tickets_beratung),

    median_waiting_time_abholung = mean(median_waiting_time_abholung, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_waiting_time_beratung = mean(median_waiting_time_beratung, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_duration_abholung = mean(median_duration_abholung, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_duration_beratung = mean(median_duration_beratung, na.rm = TRUE),

    total_tickets = sum(total_tickets, na.rm = TRUE),
    tickets_abholung = sum(tickets_abholung, na.rm = TRUE),
    tickets_beratung = sum(tickets_beratung, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    year = year(week_start),
    month = month(week_start),
    week_of_year = isoweek(week_start),
    month_start = floor_date(week_start, "month"),
    consultation_share = if_else(total_tickets > 0, tickets_beratung / total_tickets, NA_real_),
    collection_share_tickets = if_else(total_tickets > 0, tickets_abholung / total_tickets, NA_real_),
    consultation_ratio = if_else(tickets_abholung > 0, tickets_beratung / tickets_abholung, NA_real_),
    collection_workload = tickets_abholung * avg_duration_abholung,
    consultation_workload = tickets_beratung * avg_duration_beratung,
    workload_proxy = collection_workload + consultation_workload,
    waiting_time_gap = avg_waiting_time_beratung - avg_waiting_time_abholung,
    duration_gap = avg_duration_beratung - avg_duration_abholung
  ) %>%
  arrange(store, week_start)

check_unique_key(tickets_weekly, c("store", "week_start"), "tickets_weekly")

tickets_quality <- make_data_quality_report(tickets_weekly, data_name = "tickets_weekly")
tickets_quality

write_csv(tickets_weekly, file.path(output_dir, "clean_data", "tickets_weekly_dt_zh.csv"))

# The network file is kept for descriptive reference only.
if (file.exists(tickets_file_total)) {
  tickets_network <- read_csv(tickets_file_total, show_col_types = FALSE, locale = locale(encoding = "UTF-8")) %>%
    clean_names() %>%
    mutate(
      week_start = parse_week_date(week_start),

}
weekly_panel <- full_join(
  kpi_weekly,
  tickets_weekly,
  by = c("store", "week_start", "year", "month", "week_of_year", "month_start"),
  suffix = c("_kpi", "_tickets")
) %>%
  arrange(store, week_start) %>%
  filter(week_start >= analysis_start, week_start <= analysis_end) %>%
  mutate(
    store = factor(store, levels = c("DT", "ZH")),
    week_of_year_fe = factor(week_of_year),
    month_of_year_fe = factor(month),
    time_index = as.integer(difftime(week_start, min(week_start, na.rm = TRUE), units = "weeks")),
    covid = as.integer(year %in% c(2020, 2021)),
    postcovid = as.integer(year %in% c(2022, 2023)),
    newnormal = as.integer(year %in% c(2024, 2025)),
    period = case_when(
      year %in% c(2018, 2019) ~ "Pre-COVID",
      year %in% c(2020, 2021) ~ "COVID",
      year %in% c(2022, 2023) ~ "Post-COVID",
      year %in% c(2024, 2025) ~ "New Normal",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    period = factor(period, levels = c("Pre-COVID", "COVID", "Post-COVID", "New Normal")),
    fee_post = make_post_dummy(week_start, fee_date),
    steg_post = make_post_dummy(week_start, steg_date),
    melectronics_post = make_post_dummy(week_start, melectronics_date),
    competitor_post = if_else(!is.na(steg_post) | !is.na(melectronics_post),
                              as.integer(coalesce(steg_post, 0L) == 1L | coalesce(melectronics_post, 0L) == 1L),
                              NA_integer_),
    same_day_end_post = make_post_dummy(week_start, same_day_end_date)
  ) %>%
  add_log_variables()

check_unique_key(weekly_panel, c("store", "week_start"), "weekly_panel")

weekly_quality <- make_data_quality_report(weekly_panel, data_name = "weekly_panel")
weekly_quality

    first_week = min(week_start, na.rm = TRUE),
    last_week = max(week_start, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_weeks = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

panel_coverage

2.1 Model Specification Overview

This section makes the empirical specifications visible in the code report. It documents that the thesis estimates both level and log-linear fixed-effects models, uses store and seasonal fixed effects in the weekly panel, and treats productivity and NPS separately at monthly frequency.

  "avg_duration_abholung", "avg_duration_beratung",
  "median_duration_abholung", "median_duration_beratung",
  "consultation_share", "consultation_ratio", "workload_proxy"
)

main_summary_vars <- available_vars(main_summary_vars, weekly_panel)

period_summary <- weekly_panel %>%
  group_by(store, period) %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      all_of(main_summary_vars),
      list(mean = ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
           median = ~ median(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
           sd = ~ sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
           n_nonmissing = ~ sum(!is.na(.x))),
      .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"
    ),
    n_weeks = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

period_summary
write_csv(period_summary, file.path(output_dir, "tables", "period_summary_dt_zh.csv"))
period_summary_commercial <- weekly_panel %>%
  group_by(store, period) %>%
  summarise(
    `Total turnover` = mean(total_turnover, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Collection turnover` = mean(collection_turnover, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Deliveries` = mean(deliveries_collected, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Turnover per ticket` = mean(throughput_proxy, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(period = clean_period_label(period)) %>%
  rename(Store = store, Period = period)

period_summary_operational <- weekly_panel %>%
  group_by(store, period) %>%
  summarise(
    `Collection tickets` = mean(tickets_abholung, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Consultation tickets` = mean(tickets_beratung, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Collection wait` = mean(avg_waiting_time_abholung, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Consultation wait` = mean(avg_waiting_time_beratung, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(period = clean_period_label(period)) %>%
  rename(Store = store, Period = period)

3.2 Core Time-Series Figures

The descriptive time-series figures trim extreme values only for visual readability. This does not change the cleaned panel used for regression models, period summaries or event estimates. Removed plot-only outliers are saved in the diagnostics folder.

figure_vars <- c(
  total_turnover = "Weekly Total Retail Turnover",
  collection_turnover = "Weekly Collection-Related Turnover",
  deliveries_collected = "Weekly Deliveries Collected",
  total_tickets = "Weekly Total Tickets",
  tickets_abholung = "Weekly Collection Tickets",
  tickets_beratung = "Weekly Consultation Tickets",
  avg_waiting_time_abholung = "Average Waiting Time: Collection",
  avg_waiting_time_beratung = "Average Waiting Time: Consultation",
  avg_duration_abholung = "Average Duration: Collection",
  avg_duration_beratung = "Average Duration: Consultation",
  throughput_proxy = "Turnover per Ticket"
)

for (v in names(figure_vars)) {
  y_label <- if (v %in% names(model_label_map)) {
    unname(model_label_map[v])
  } else {
    v
  }

  p <- plot_weekly_series(weekly_panel, v, figure_vars[[v]], y_label = y_label)
  if (!is.null(p)) {
    print(p)
    ggsave(
      filename = file.path(output_dir, "figures", paste0("weekly_", v, ".png")),
      plot = p,
      width = 10,
      height = 5,
      bg = "white"
    )
    save_plot_png(p, paste0("fig_weekly_", v, ".png"), width = 10, height = 5)
  }
}

4 Baseline Fixed-Effects Models: Period Comparison

The following tables are formatted for empirical review. The full table files are also exported separately in the output folder and can be copied into the thesis appendix if needed.

The period models compare COVID, Post-COVID and New Normal with Pre-COVID as the omitted baseline. In this two-store setting, full calendar-week fixed effects would absorb the period variables. The baseline therefore uses store fixed effects and week-of-year fixed effects. A linear time trend is included in selected robustness specifications.

4.1 Commercial Outcomes

  "total_turnover",
  "direct_turnover",
  "direct_turnover_all",
  "direct_turnover_relevant",

5 Event-Based Fixed-Effects Models

Event models are estimated only if the corresponding event date is filled in and the event dummy has variation. Models that cannot be estimated are automatically logged in model_log.

event_date_audit <- tibble(
  event = c("CHF 4.90 small-order fee", "STEG exit", "melectronics exit", "Same-day delivery cancellation"),
  exact_event_date = c(fee_date, steg_date, melectronics_date, same_day_end_date),
  weekly_event_start = event_week_start(exact_event_date),
  status = if_else(is.na(exact_event_date), "Missing: model skipped", "Available")
)

knitr::kable(
  event_date_audit,
  caption = "Event dates used in event-based specifications"
)

  event_date_audit,
  "tab_event_dates.png",
  title = "Event dates used in event-based specifications",
  note = "Weekly event start is the Monday of the week containing the event date.",
  digits = 0
)

The fee and competitor models require confirmed event dates. If the event date is still missing, the corresponding model is not estimated, because an event dummy without variation would produce invalid or misleading results.

6 Event-Overlap and Serial-Dependence Sensitivity

The main event indicators remain equal to one after their respective event dates. Their post-periods therefore overlap. The following sensitivity analysis first enters all four event indicators simultaneously. It then estimates separate local models in symmetric eight-week windows around each event; these clean-window models include store fixed effects and a linear event-time trend, but not week-of-year fixed effects, which would absorb the event indicator inside a single narrow calendar window. For the fee, the eight post-event weeks end before the melectronics event week.

The same joint-event specification is finally re-estimated with Newey–West standard errors using four weekly lags. This changes the estimated precision, not the coefficients, and is treated as a sensitivity check because only two stores are observed and no untreated comparison group exists.

robustness_outcomes <- c(
  "deliveries_collected",
  "collection_turnover",
  "tickets_abholung",
  "total_tickets",
  "avg_waiting_time_abholung",
  "tickets_beratung",
  "avg_waiting_time_beratung",
  "throughput_proxy"
)
robustness_outcomes <- available_vars(robustness_outcomes, weekly_panel)

joint_event_rhs <- paste(
  c("steg_post", "fee_post", "melectronics_post", "same_day_end_post"),
  collapse = " + "
)

prepare_clean_window <- function(data, event_date, window_weeks = 8) {
  event_start <- event_week_start(event_date)

  data %>%
    mutate(
      event_time = as.integer(difftime(week_start, event_start, units = "weeks")),
      clean_post = as.integer(event_time >= 0)
    ) %>%
    filter(event_time >= -window_weeks, event_time <= window_weeks - 1)
}

run_clean_window_set <- function(event_name, event_date, outcomes, window_weeks = 8) {
  clean_data <- prepare_clean_window(weekly_panel, event_date, window_weeks)

  models <- map(
    available_vars(outcomes, clean_data),
    ~ run_fe_model(
      data = clean_data,
      outcome = .x,
      rhs = "clean_post + event_time",
      model_group = paste(event_name, "clean window"),
      transform = "log",
      fixed_effects = "store",
      min_n = 20
    )
  )
  names(models) <- available_vars(outcomes, clean_data)
  compact(models)
}

run_nw_joint_model <- function(data, outcome, lag_length = 4) {
  y <- paste0("ln_", outcome)
  required <- c(
    y, "store", "week_start", "week_of_year_fe",
    "steg_post", "fee_post", "melectronics_post", "same_day_end_post"
  )

  if (!all(required %in% names(data))) {
    log_model_status(
      "Joint events Newey-West", outcome, "log", "skipped",
      glue("Missing variable(s): {paste(setdiff(required, names(data)), collapse = ', ')}")
    )
    return(NULL)
  }

  model_data <- data %>% select(all_of(required)) %>% drop_na()
  fml <- as.formula(glue("{y} ~ {joint_event_rhs} | store + week_of_year_fe"))

  fit <- tryCatch(
    feols(
      fml,
      data = model_data,
      panel.id = ~ store + week_start,
      vcov = NW(lag_length),
      notes = FALSE
    ),
    error = function(e) e
  )

  if (inherits(fit, "error")) {
    log_model_status("Joint events Newey-West", outcome, "log", "error", fit$message)
    return(NULL)
  }

  log_model_status("Joint events Newey-West", outcome, "log", "estimated", "")
  fit
}

tidy_robustness_models <- function(models, specification, terms) {
  imap_dfr(compact(models), function(model, outcome_name) {
    broom::tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
      filter(term %in% terms) %>%
      transmute(
        Specification = specification,
        Outcome = if_else(
          outcome_name %in% names(model_label_map),
          unname(model_label_map[outcome_name]),
          outcome_name
        ),
        Event = if_else(
          term %in% names(coef_label_map),
          unname(coef_label_map[term]),
          term
        ),
        Coefficient = estimate,
        `Approx. percent change` = 100 * (exp(estimate) - 1),
        `Std. error` = std.error,
        `p-value` = p.value,
        `CI lower` = conf.low,
        `CI upper` = conf.high
      )
  })
}

  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)))

8 Event Study and Coefficient Plots

The event-study figures trace weekly dynamics around the event dates. Unlike the baseline event regressions, the event-study plots use store fixed effects only. This avoids over-controlling the narrow event window with week-of-year fixed effects, which would absorb most event-time variation and create visually misleading coefficient plots.

prepare_event_study_data <- function(data, event_date, window = 26) {
  if (is.na(event_date)) return(NULL)

  event_start <- event_week_start(event_date)

  data %>%
    mutate(
      event_week = as.integer(difftime(week_start, event_start, units = "weeks"))
    ) %>%
    filter(event_week >= -window, event_week <= window)
}

run_event_study <- function(data, outcome, event_date, model_group, transform = "log", window = 26) {
  es_data <- prepare_event_study_data(data, event_date, window)

  if (is.null(es_data) || nrow(es_data) == 0) {
    log_model_status(model_group, outcome, transform, "skipped", "Event date missing or no observations in event window.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  y <- if (transform == "log") paste0("ln_", outcome) else if (transform == "log1p") paste0("ln1p_", outcome) else outcome

  if (!y %in% names(es_data)) {
    log_model_status(model_group, outcome, transform, "skipped", glue("Outcome {y} not found."))
    return(NULL)
  }

  if (!(-1 %in% es_data$event_week)) {
    log_model_status(model_group, outcome, transform, "skipped", "Reference week -1 is not available in the event window.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  if (n_distinct(es_data$event_week, na.rm = TRUE) < 4) {
    log_model_status(model_group, outcome, transform, "skipped", "Insufficient event-time variation.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  fml <- as.formula(glue("{y} ~ i(event_week, ref = -1) | store"))

  fit <- tryCatch(
    feols(fml, data = es_data, vcov = "hetero", notes = FALSE),
    error = function(e) e
  )

  if (inherits(fit, "error")) {
    log_model_status(model_group, outcome, transform, "error", fit$message)
    return(NULL)
  }

  log_model_status(model_group, outcome, transform, "estimated", "")
  fit
}

tidy_event_study <- function(model, outcome_name) {
  pretty_outcome <- if_else(
    outcome_name %in% names(model_label_map),
    unname(model_label_map[outcome_name]),
    outcome_name
  )

  broom::tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    filter(str_detect(term, "event_week")) %>%
    mutate(
      event_week = as.integer(str_match(term, "::(-?\\d+)")[, 2]),
      outcome = pretty_outcome
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(event_week))
}

plot_event_study_set <- function(event_name, event_date, outcomes, file_prefix, window = 26) {
  if (is.na(event_date)) {
    cat(glue("\\textit{{{event_name}: no event-study plot is shown because the event date is missing in the setup chunk.}}\\n\\n"))
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  outcomes <- available_vars(outcomes, weekly_panel)

  models <- map(
    outcomes,
    ~ run_event_study(
      weekly_panel,
      .x,
      event_date,
      model_group = paste(event_name, "event study"),
      transform = "log",
      window = window
    )
  )
  names(models) <- outcomes
  models <- compact(models)

  if (length(models) == 0) {
    cat(glue("\\textit{{{event_name}: no event-study model could be estimated. See diagnostics/model_log.csv.}}\\n\\n"))
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  plot_df <- imap_dfr(models, tidy_event_study)

  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) {
    cat(glue("\\textit{{{event_name}: no event-study coefficients are available for plotting.}}\\n\\n"))
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = event_week, y = estimate)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", linewidth = 0.25) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high), width = 0.15, alpha = 0.65) +
    geom_point(size = 1.5) +
    facet_wrap(~ outcome, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Event-study coefficients:", event_name),
      subtitle = "Reference period is week -1. Models include store fixed effects.",
      x = "Weeks relative to event",
      y = "Coefficient relative to week -1"
    )

  print(p)
  event_filename <- paste0("event_study_", file_prefix, "_combined.png")
  ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "figures", event_filename), p, width = 9, height = 6, bg = "white")
  save_plot_png(p, event_filename, width = 9, height = 6)
  invisible(models)
}

  event_date = fee_date,

9 Store Heterogeneity

run_heterogeneity_model <- function(data, outcome, event_var, model_group, transform = "log") {
  y <- if (transform == "log") paste0("ln_", outcome) else if (transform == "log1p") paste0("ln1p_", outcome) else outcome
  if (!y %in% names(data)) {
    log_model_status(model_group, outcome, transform, "skipped", glue("Outcome {y} not found."))
    return(NULL)
  }
  if (!event_var %in% names(data)) {
    log_model_status(model_group, outcome, transform, "skipped", glue("Event variable {event_var} not found."))
    return(NULL)
  }
  if (all(is.na(data[[event_var]])) || n_distinct(data[[event_var]], na.rm = TRUE) <= 1) {
    log_model_status(model_group, outcome, transform, "skipped", glue("Event variable {event_var} has no usable variation."))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  fml <- as.formula(glue("{y} ~ {event_var} * store | week_of_year_fe"))
  fit <- tryCatch(
    feols(fml, data = data, vcov = "hetero", notes = FALSE),
    error = function(e) e
  )
  if (inherits(fit, "error")) {
    log_model_status(model_group, outcome, transform, "error", fit$message)
    return(NULL)
  }
  log_model_status(model_group, outcome, transform, "estimated", "")
  fit
}

10 Monthly Productivity Analysis

The newly available productivity series is observed monthly for Dietikon and Zurich from 2018 to 2025. It is analysed separately from the weekly panel to avoid artificial interpolation. The April 2020 value is zero for both stores because the stores were closed during the COVID-19 restrictions. These zeros are valid observations and are retained in the main analysis. The preferred productivity specifications are therefore estimated in levels. Log specifications on positive months are reported only as robustness checks.

require_file(productivity_file)

productivity_monthly <- read_csv(
  productivity_file,
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(
    month_start = as.Date(month_start),
    productivity = parse_numeric(as.character(productivity)),
    productivity_raw = parse_numeric(as.character(productivity_raw)),
    store = factor(store, levels = c("DT", "ZH")),
    year = year(month_start),
    month = month(month_start),
    month_of_year_fe = factor(month),
    period = case_when(
      year %in% c(2018, 2019) ~ "Pre-COVID",
      year %in% c(2020, 2021) ~ "COVID",
      year %in% c(2022, 2023) ~ "Post-COVID",
      year %in% c(2024, 2025) ~ "New Normal",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    period = factor(
      period,
      levels = c("Pre-COVID", "COVID", "Post-COVID", "New Normal")
    ),
    covid = as.integer(period == "COVID"),
    postcovid = as.integer(period == "Post-COVID"),
    newnormal = as.integer(period == "New Normal"),
    fee_post = as.integer(month_start >= floor_date(fee_date, "month")),
    steg_post = as.integer(month_start >= floor_date(steg_date, "month")),
    melectronics_post = as.integer(
      month_start >= floor_date(melectronics_date, "month")
    ),
    same_day_end_post = as.integer(
      month_start >= floor_date(same_day_end_date, "month")
    ),
    ln_productivity = if_else(productivity > 0, log(productivity), NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  filter(year >= 2018, year <= 2025)

productivity_quality <- make_data_quality_report(
  productivity_monthly,
  data_name = "productivity_monthly"
)
productivity_quality

write_csv(
  productivity_monthly,
  file.path(output_dir, "clean_data", "productivity_monthly_dt_zh.csv")
)

10.2 Monthly Productivity Regressions

The main productivity regressions are estimated in levels so that the April 2020 closure observations remain in the sample. Log specifications on positive months are reported as robustness checks.

productivity_level_notes <- c(
  "April 2020 zeros are retained as valid observations reflecting COVID-19 store closure.",
  "Heteroskedasticity-robust standard errors in parentheses.",
  "Models include store and month-of-year fixed effects unless stated otherwise.",
  significance_note
)

model_productivity_period_level <- run_fe_model(
  data = productivity_monthly,
  outcome = "productivity",
  rhs = "covid + postcovid + newnormal",
  model_group = "Monthly productivity",
  transform = "level",
  fixed_effects = "store + month_of_year_fe",
  min_n = 30
)

model_productivity_fee_level <- run_fe_model(

10.3 Productivity Store Heterogeneity

model_productivity_fee_heterogeneity <- tryCatch(
  feols(
    productivity ~ fee_post * store | month_of_year_fe,
    data = productivity_monthly,
    vcov = "hetero",
    notes = FALSE
  ),
  error = function(e) NULL
)

if (!is.null(model_productivity_fee_heterogeneity)) {
  display_model_table(
    list("Monthly productivity" = model_productivity_fee_heterogeneity),
    "Monthly productivity: fee-event store heterogeneity",

      "Heteroskedasticity-robust standard errors in parentheses.",
      "The model includes month-of-year fixed effects.",
      "The dependent variable is monthly productivity in levels.",

  save_model_table(

11 Monthly NPS Analysis

read_nps_store <- function(path, store_code) {
  require_file(path)
  raw <- read_tsv(path, locale = locale(encoding = "UTF-16LE"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    clean_names()
  
  # The export uses long German column names, so positions are more stable here.
  col_month <- names(raw)[1]
  col_class <- names(raw)[2]
  col_nps_decimal <- names(raw)[4]
  col_weight <- names(raw)[5]
  col_share <- names(raw)[6]
  
  raw %>%
    transmute(
      store = store_code,
      month_start = parse_nps_month(.data[[col_month]]),
      ppd_classification = as.character(.data[[col_class]]),
      nps_decimal = parse_numeric(.data[[col_nps_decimal]]),
      nps_score = nps_decimal * 100,
      nps_weight = parse_numeric(.data[[col_weight]]),
      response_share = parse_numeric(.data[[col_share]]) / 100
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(month_start))
}

nps_long <- bind_rows(
  read_nps_store(nps_file_dt, "DT"),
  read_nps_store(nps_file_zh, "ZH")
) %>%
  filter(month_start >= floor_date(analysis_start, "month"),
         month_start <= floor_date(analysis_end, "month"))

nps_monthly <- nps_long %>%
  group_by(store, month_start) %>%
  summarise(
    nps_decimal = mean(nps_decimal, na.rm = TRUE),
    nps_score = mean(nps_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    detractor_share = sum(response_share[ppd_classification == "Detractor"], na.rm = TRUE),
    passive_share = sum(response_share[ppd_classification == "Passive"], na.rm = TRUE),
    promoter_share = sum(response_share[ppd_classification == "Promoter"], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    store = factor(store, levels = c("DT", "ZH")),
    year = year(month_start),
    month = month(month_start),
    month_of_year_fe = factor(month),
    fee_post = make_post_dummy(month_start, floor_date(fee_date, "month")),
    steg_post = make_post_dummy(month_start, floor_date(steg_date, "month")),
    melectronics_post = make_post_dummy(month_start, floor_date(melectronics_date, "month")),
    same_day_end_post = make_post_dummy(month_start, floor_date(same_day_end_date, "month"))
  )

nps_quality <- make_data_quality_report(nps_monthly, data_name = "nps_monthly")
nps_quality

write_csv(nps_long, file.path(output_dir, "clean_data", "nps_long_dt_zh.csv"))
write_csv(nps_monthly, file.path(output_dir, "clean_data", "nps_monthly_dt_zh.csv"))
monthly_ops <- weekly_panel %>%
  group_by(store, month_start) %>%
  summarise(
    total_turnover = sum(total_turnover, na.rm = TRUE),
    collection_turnover = sum(collection_turnover, na.rm = TRUE),
    turnover_collected = sum(turnover_collected, na.rm = TRUE),
    deliveries_collected = sum(deliveries_collected, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_tickets = sum(total_tickets, na.rm = TRUE),
    tickets_abholung = sum(tickets_abholung, na.rm = TRUE),
    tickets_beratung = sum(tickets_beratung, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_waiting_time_abholung = mean(avg_waiting_time_abholung, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_waiting_time_beratung = mean(avg_waiting_time_beratung, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_duration_abholung = mean(avg_duration_abholung, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_duration_beratung = mean(avg_duration_beratung, na.rm = TRUE),
    throughput_proxy = mean(throughput_proxy, na.rm = TRUE),
    consultation_share = if_else(total_tickets > 0, tickets_beratung / total_tickets, NA_real_),
    workload_proxy = sum(workload_proxy, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  add_log_variables()

nps_panel <- nps_monthly %>%
  left_join(monthly_ops, by = c("store", "month_start")) %>%
  mutate(
    time_index = as.integer(interval(min(month_start, na.rm = TRUE), month_start) %/% months(1))
  )

nps_panel_quality <- make_data_quality_report(nps_panel, data_name = "nps_panel")
nps_panel_quality

write_csv(nps_panel, file.path(output_dir, "clean_data", "nps_monthly_panel_dt_zh.csv"))
nps_models <- list()

nps_models[["NPS | same-day cancellation"]] <- run_fe_model(

  outcome = "nps_score",

  fixed_effects = "store + month_of_year_fe",

)

nps_models[["NPS | operational pressure"]] <- run_fe_model(

)

12 AI-Supported Workload Simulation

automation_rates <- tibble(automation_rate = c(0.10, 0.20, 0.30))

workload_simulation <- weekly_panel %>%
  select(store, week_start, period, tickets_abholung, tickets_beratung,
         avg_duration_abholung, avg_duration_beratung, workload_proxy) %>%
  crossing(automation_rates) %>%
  mutate(
    saved_time = automation_rate * tickets_abholung * avg_duration_abholung,
    remaining_workload = workload_proxy - saved_time,
    workload_reduction_share = if_else(workload_proxy > 0, saved_time / workload_proxy, NA_real_)
  )

workload_summary <- workload_simulation %>%
  group_by(store, period, automation_rate) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_workload = mean(workload_proxy, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_saved_time = mean(saved_time, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_remaining_workload = mean(remaining_workload, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_reduction_share = mean(workload_reduction_share, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_weeks = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

workload_summary
write_csv(workload_summary, file.path(output_dir, "tables", "workload_simulation_summary.csv"))
save_df_table_png(
  workload_summary,
  "tab_workload_simulation_summary.png",
  title = "AI-supported workload simulation summary",
  note = "Scenario calculation based on partial automation of routine collection interactions."
)

workload_summary <- workload_summary %>%
  mutate(
    period_label = factor(
      period,
      levels = c("Pre-COVID", "COVID", "Post-COVID", "New Normal"),
      labels = c("Pre-COVID", "COVID", "Post-COVID", "New Normal")
    ),
    automation_label = factor(
      automation_rate,
      levels = c(0.10, 0.20, 0.30),
      labels = c("10%", "20%", "30%")
    )
  )

p_workload <- ggplot(workload_summary, aes(x = mean_saved_time, y = period_label, fill = automation_label)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.65) +
  facet_wrap(~ store) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(
    title = "Simulated Saved Routine Workload",
    subtitle = "Scenario calculation based on partial automation of routine collection interactions",
    x = "Mean saved routine workload per week",
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Routine automation"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

print(p_workload)

ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "figures", "workload_simulation.png"), p_workload, width = 9, height = 5, bg = "white")
save_plot_png(p_workload, "workload_simulation.png", width = 9, height = 5)

13 Exported Appendix PNG Files

All thesis-relevant figures and tables are exported as PNG files. The files for direct appendix upload are saved in output/appendix_png. Regression tables include a note explaining the significance stars: *** p < 0.001, ** p < 0.01, * p < 0.05. Table PNGs are rendered directly with grid/gridExtra and do not require Chrome, webshot2, or PhantomJS.

variable_availability <- tibble(
  variable = sort(names(weekly_panel)),
  type = map_chr(weekly_panel, ~ class(.x)[1]),
  n_missing = map_int(weekly_panel, ~ sum(is.na(.x))),
  n_distinct = map_int(weekly_panel, ~ n_distinct(.x, na.rm = TRUE))
)

write_csv(variable_availability, file.path(output_dir, "diagnostics", "variable_availability_weekly_panel.csv"))
